title: Flash Percent — Fast Fashion Siren
description: A retail-grade sale headline engineered around one colossal percentage figure — no gradients, no texture, just a hard rectangular color block, four words of imperative copy, and a black price-tag anchor that stops a scroll cold.
philosophy: This template exists to manufacture urgency, not earn admiration. It steals its visual grammar directly from H&M and Zara email blasts: compressed black display type pushed to an almost violent scale, a single unbroken color field, and zero decorative elements that could dilute the sale signal. It refuses softness — no rounded corners, no gradient wash, no whitespace breathing room. The speaker is a retailer; the room is an inbox, a pop-up event, or a Black Friday war room, and every design decision serves conversion over craft.
goodFor: Black Friday and Cyber Monday promotional storyboards
Social-story ad concept frames requiring a single dominant number
avoidFor: Luxury or premium brand presentations where restraint signals value
Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews needing data legibility
Academic or research paper slide decks
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide is a retail war cry — one enormous sale figure detonates across the frame with near-violent scale, leaving almost no surrounding air to soften it. The mood is a Black Friday warehouse floor or a fast-fashion email blast: confrontational, blunt, zero sentimentality, zero craft-signaling. Compositional rhythm is deliberately flat and frontal — a single unbroken color field, hard rectangular geometry, and brute weight contrast between the dominant number and the stripped-down copy below. Refuse every impulse toward elegance: no curves, no layering, no texture, no decorative breathing room.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed rectangular color block covers the entire canvas with zero outer margin — no breathing room, edge-to-edge in every direction. A 12-column grid anchors the colossal percentage numeral spanning the full width across the upper two-thirds of the vertical height, contained by no frame or padding. Four words of tight imperative uppercase copy occupy a narrow horizontal band directly below the figure, separated by a single hard rule line. A solid price-tag lockup sits flush to the bottom edge, left-aligned, functioning as a dead-weight anchor that pins the composition.

examples.promptCore: The slide hits like a Zara flash-sale email printed at billboard scale — a single colossal number occupies the left mass like a battering ram while stacked imperative commands on the right read as orders, not suggestions. Composition is hard-asymmetric and deliberately airless: numeric dominance on the left, compressed verbal urgency on the right, and a price-anchor bar slamming the bottom edge closed with no transition. The mood is controlled aggression — retail-grade, conversion-obsessed, stripped of every element that could soften the sale signal or invite the eye to linger anywhere but the offer.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed flat color field, zero outer margin relief — edge-to-edge on all four sides. A 12-column grid positions the colossal percentage figure in cols 1–7, scaled to deliberately clip beyond the top and bottom slide edges so only the numeric mass is visible, not its cap or descender. Imperative copy stacks in 3–4 compressed lines flush-right in cols 8–12, vertically centered against the number. A full-width solid black anchor bar occupies the bottom 15% of the slide height, separated from the color field by a single hard hairline rule, housing the price-tag callout in reversed contrast with no internal padding.
